reason: I'd use the free first visit to check it out, but $15 a visit for a toddler is a lot on our budget when the library and the park cost nothing. With shifts at the hospital, I can't count on getting there often enough to make a pack or membership worth it.
objection: Will bigger kids be running wild around my baby? The Baby Nook sounds good, but I'd need to see it myself, and $15 a visit is hard to justify when we're stretching every paycheck.
would_change_my_mind: A drop-in around $8-10 or a 5-visit pack closer to $40, plus seeing on the free visit that the Baby Nook really keeps the little ones safe from the bigger kids.
